result.instructions: This endpoint answers for exactly one broker mission: "mcp-transcript". The mission is part of the URL, not a tool argument. Writes present the lease's authority ({capability, fencingToken}) that orchestrator_claim answered; a worker's reports present the job's own ({jobId, capability}). agent_await never waits: poll it. A refusal is the broker's envelope (error, message, recovery, retryable, details) in structuredContent, with isError.

tools.name: orchestrator_claim
tools.title: Claim this mission's lease
tools.description: Take the mission's lease for your provider. Answers the authority (capability and fencing token) every write presents, and the heartbeat deadline. Another holder's live lease is a CONFLICT naming its owner.

tools.name: orchestrator_heartbeat
tools.title: Renew the lease
tools.description: Renew the lease you hold before its heartbeat deadline, presenting its capability and fencing token.

tools.name: orchestrator_release
tools.title: Release the lease
tools.description: Give the lease up, presenting its capability and fencing token. The next claim starts a new epoch.

tools.name: orchestrator_status
tools.title: Read the lease and what is owed
tools.description: Who holds the mission's lease and until when, with the attention block: what is waiting on the orchestrator.

tools.name: roles_list
tools.title: List the declared roles
tools.description: Every declared role side (role, provider, tools): the ceilings a dispatch may name.

tools.name: roles_propose
tools.title: Check proposed roles without declaring them
tools.description: Judge proposed role sides by the registry's own rules (name, tool vocabulary, at least one tool) and write nothing. Declaring is an administrator's act over POST /v1/roles.

tools.name: work_add
tools.title: File work items
tools.description: File one to 500 work items (title, intent, optional parent, horizon and discoveredFrom) under the lease. Answers their ids in order.

tools.name: work_adopt
tools.title: Adopt a completed job's decomposition
tools.description: File the items a completed job proposed, each a part of its work item or a follow-on, under the lease.

tools.name: work_list
tools.title: Read the work list
tools.description: Every work item with its derived state (horizon, readiness, blockers, open questions, job counts) and the list's progress.

tools.name: work_close
tools.title: Close a work item
tools.description: Close a work item as delivered, dropped or superseded, under the lease.

tools.name: work_move
tools.title: Move work items between horizons
tools.description: Place work items on a horizon (now, next, later, someday), under the lease.

tools.name: work_ask
tools.title: Ask the owner a question
tools.description: Raise a question on a work item, with an optional proposal the owner can accept as it stands, under the lease.

tools.name: work_relay_answer
tools.title: Relay an answer to a question
tools.description: Carry an answer you obtained to an open question; the owner confirms it before it counts.

tools.name: work_withdraw
tools.title: Withdraw a question
tools.description: Take back a question you raised, with a reason. Withdrawing is not answering.

tools.name: work_delegate
tools.title: Delegate a question to a provider
tools.description: Hand an open question to a provider to answer, under the lease.

tools.name: agent_submit
tools.title: Dispatch a job
tools.description: Dispatch a job on a declared role side. Answers the job id and, on creation only, the job's capability, with the attention block. The Worker records the job; a daemon runs it.

tools.name: agent_attach
tools.title: Attach a run to a job
tools.description: Bind a provider run (and optionally its worktree) to a job, presenting the job's own authority. Answers the job's brief.

tools.name: agent_report
tools.title: Report a job's end
tools.description: Settle a job as completed, failed, timed_out or cancelled, with its output or error, presenting the job's own authority.

tools.name: agent_list
tools.title: List the jobs
tools.description: Every job of the mission with its state, and the mission's digest.

tools.name: agent_running
tools.title: What is running now
tools.description: The jobs whose worker is live (reserved or running), each with its work item's title, its last progress line and when it started, with the attention block.

tools.name: agent_await
tools.title: Has anything changed
tools.description: Answers at once whether the mission changed since the digest you last saw, with the attention block. It never waits: poll it (the wapps daemon polls every two seconds up to 55).

tools.name: agent_status
tools.title: Read one job
tools.description: One job and its progress lines, with the attention block.

tools.name: agent_result
tools.title: Read a job's result
tools.description: A settled job's result. Reading it marks it read, which is what discharges it from the attention block.

tools.name: agent_cancel
tools.title: Cancel a job
tools.description: Cancel a job under the lease. The Worker records it; the process is stopped by whoever runs it.
